messages:
alex_g: Quick heads-up — tomorrow's SRE onsite panel needs one small runbook/rubric tweak and a logistics swap. Please read and react.

maya_k: TL;DR? what changed?

alex_g: Candidate J is now using a Codespaces link instead of local env. pls score the debugging task expecting slightly slower setup time. Also room change: 3B -> Blue Conf.

samir_p: noted for scoring. can we add a quick rubric line: 'accounts for tool/setup flakiness' ?

elena: agree with samir, otherwise folks might penalize for network hiccups.

maya_k: added a checkbox to the debrief doc: 1) env issues encountered 2) how candidate mitigated. link: https://docs.internal/runs/debriefs/sre-j

priya: I can cover 3:10 slot — kevin, you still on for 4pm?

kevin_l: something came up, can swap with priya, 4pm is rough. priya can take 4p, i take 3:10. all good?

priya: yep i can do 4pm. swapping calendar now.

interview-bot: Calendar updated: priya -> 4:00pm, kevin -> 3:10pm (updated by priya).

alex_g: thanks — last quick rubric clarification: for systems-design piece please focus on tradeoffs and monitoring plan over exact memory math. scoring buckets: 
```
4: clear tradeoffs, monitoring + fallback
3: mentions tradeoffs, basic metrics
2: sketchy monitoring, missing fallback
1: no tradeoffs or observability
```

samir_p: can we add a small note: if candidate proposes expensive redundancy, ask for cost mitigations?

alex_g: good call — adding: 'if proposing >2x resource, probe for cost mitigation or alternative'.

elena: debrief owner? who consolidates notes after panel?

maya_k: i'll collect debriefs and post summary in #hiring-summary by EOD tomorrow.

priya: quick reminder to panel: please capture exact prompt used for the debugging task and any commands candidate ran. small logs help later.

kevin_l: will do. also adding :thumbsup: to doc when done.

alex_g: final: please skim the runbook before the panel — link again: https://docs.internal/runs/runbook-sre-onsite. react with :eyes: when done so i can close this thread.

maya_k: :eyes:

samir_p: :eyes:

elena: :eyes:

interview-bot: Reminder scheduled: 30m before panel.

alex_g: thanks all — see you tomorrow.
